title.en: Find the BGP messages in the capture

why.en: Open the .pcap in Wireshark and show only BGP (TCP port 179): OPEN, KEEPALIVE, UPDATE and NOTIFICATION.
why.hinglish: .pcap Wireshark mein kholo aur sirf BGP (TCP port 179) dikhao: OPEN, KEEPALIVE, UPDATE aur NOTIFICATION.

expect.en: OPEN from each side (AS64500 and AS64496), KEEPALIVEs, then the UPDATE carrying 203.0.113.0/24 with its path attributes.
expect.hinglish: Har side se OPEN (AS64500 aur AS64496), KEEPALIVEs, phir path attributes ke saath 203.0.113.0/24 wala UPDATE.

why.en: Filter UPDATE messages and expand the path attributes to see AS_PATH grow as the route is passed on.
why.hinglish: UPDATE messages filter karo aur path attributes expand karo ki route aage pass hone par AS_PATH kaise badhta hai.

expect.en: AS_PATH 64500 on the first UPDATE and 64496 64500 on the one sent to ISP B; the hijack scenario shows a /25 originated by 64511.
expect.hinglish: Pehle UPDATE par AS_PATH 64500 aur ISP B ko bheje gaye par 64496 64500; hijack scenario mein 64511 se originate hua /25 dikhta hai.

why.en: In the hold-timer scenario the transit ends the session with a NOTIFICATION.
why.hinglish: Hold-timer scenario mein transit session ko NOTIFICATION se khatam karta hai.

expect.en: A 21-byte NOTIFICATION with error code 4 (Hold Timer Expired), followed by the TCP FIN.
expect.hinglish: Error code 4 (Hold Timer Expired) wala 21-byte NOTIFICATION, uske baad TCP FIN.

title.en: Look up who owns an AS number

why.en: A safe, read-only lookup of a real network's AS number and the prefixes it announces, using public data.
why.hinglish: Public data se kisi asli network ke AS number aur uske announce kiye prefixes ka safe, read-only lookup.

expect.en: The answer shows AS15169 (Google) for 8.8.8.8 with the announced prefix 8.8.8.0/24, the registry and the allocation date. Exact output differs by tool and over time.
expect.hinglish: Jawab 8.8.8.8 ke liye AS15169 (Google) announced prefix 8.8.8.0/24, registry aur allocation date ke saath dikhata hai. Exact output tool aur samay ke hisaab se alag hota hai.
